rows.title: LONDON TONIGHT FREESTYLE (feat. Skepta, Novelist & A$AP Rocky)
AHH YA HABILE (feat. WAJA33)
notes: “It was Aya Khabile by Billy Tiestyark, featuring Wajah 33”
Beirut rapper BILLY TSTRK's dark trap single featuring WAJA33 (M7DH0N collective); ASR heavily mangled all three names.

rows.title: Zahab La Rogoo3 (feat. Zaf)
notes: “This next track is Zahab Lah Ragukh by Jana featuring Zaf”
Opening track of Egyptian producer Jana's 2026 EP 'Khazan A7zan', featuring Zaf; matches announced title in transliteration.

rows.title: Elswad (السواد)
notes: “Right at the top was Young Giza's El Swad.”
Egyptian rapper Young Giza's track 'Elswad', official audio confirmed on YouTube.

rows.title: Speed Demon
notes: “before that one was Speed Demon by Lucy Bedrock, a recent release.”
'Speed Demon' by Lucy Bedroque, released 19 Aug 2026 on deadAir — matches 'a recent release' and near-homophone 'Lucy Bedrock'.

rows.title: Paleta
notes: Trap/hyperpop single by LA-based rommulas (of boylife collective with 2hollis); 'Romulus's' is ASR mangling 'rommulas's'.

rows.title: Who's Next
notes: “That one was Who's Next by Ja Bulani.”

rows.title: Four Blessings
notes: “Before that one was Four Blessings by Rainbow Chan”
'Four Blessings' is a real single by Sydney/Hong Kong artist Rainbow Chan, from her 2026 album The Bridal Lament (Music In Exile).

rows.title: Re Slash Up
notes: “This next track is Re Slash Up by Babyface featuring Ruka and Survival. Language warning for this one.”

rows.title: LOOK OUT FOR ME (FOUR TET VERSION)
WannaCry
notes: “a lot of recent releases such as Nina Jarci and Porter Omba's What a Cry at the End of the Hour so hopefully you're looking forward to that”
'WannaCry' by Ninajirachi and Porter Robinson (28 Jul 2026); ASR mangled 'Ninajirachi'→'Nina Jarci', 'Porter Robinson'→'Porter Omba', 'WannaCry'→'What a Cry'.

rows.title: Music Baby
notes: 2025 Jane Remover under exclusive license to deadAir

'Dam' / 'Dam 2' single by Beirut artist WAJA33 (also featured in entry 1); matches presenter's 'Damn 2 by Wajah 33' closely.

mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played

mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
e fishpool (Yuin artist, past FBi Radio Album of the Week) released 'Sanctuary' on 13 Aug 2026, including track 'Rosedale' — timing matches 'album of the week from around a month ago'.
